name: Voice and multimodal connectors

vitest.details: Multimodal registry and Phase 35 testing suite successful.

gate.details: 17/17 source assertions. This gate did not exist when the phase was first recorded VERIFIED_COMPLETE; package.json referenced scripts/check-stage2-phase35.mjs but the file was never written, so the command failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

changes: Implemented MultimodalRegistry for Voice, Vision, Media, and Headless Connectors
Added Phase 35 requirement tests ensuring zero startup delay
Wrote the missing scripts/check-stage2-phase35.mjs gate the phase had been certified without
Hardened MultimodalRegistry: malformed and duplicate registrations are refused rather than silently overwriting a provider
Declared the multimodal registry as a non-runtime module; it has no production consumer
runtimeBoundary: No microphone, speaker or recorded-audio runtime has been exercised. Voice contracts and redaction are verified by source only.
